prompt:
full-body portrait card, creature centered, dramatic warm rim light from the side, soft even lighting. subject: L'Hydre, the Lernaean hydra, a huge serpentine monster with five long necks and five snake heads rising in a fan, olive-green scales fading to deep Aegean blue on the back and a pale cream belly, each head with a different expressive attitude, one hissing, one grinning, one curious, one sleepy, one snapping, and on one side a cut neck stump from which two small new heads are sprouting, coiled thick body and tail, (blood gore:-3) (scenery:-3) (cast shadow:-2), isolated on a flat plain white background.

Style: a painterly young-adult fantasy novel cover illustration with clean confident linework, soft cel shading with rich painted light, appealing slightly stylised proportions and expressive faces, in a sun-bleached Mediterranean palette of marble white, warm terracotta, olive green and deep Aegean blue with small burnished gold accents; dramatic but never gory or horrific, adventurous and a little theatrical, the feel of a Greek-mythology adventure book for teenagers.
